system.description:
Once per Doom Quarter, roll 1 Skill Die to turn into a monster: Grit = Corpse Titan (p191), Wit = Night Gaunt (p181), Smarts = Werewolf (p173), Heart = Dryad (p172), Strange = Abomination (p180), Luck = your choice. Each Combat Round you stay transformed, make a CR 3 Smarts Check; on a failure your form becomes unstable and you gain 1 wound.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.48
